Archived Run: RUN-dd7b7d19c1c645b9a470551ad36f4784
Archived attempt: wfc-beta1-bp7-guidance-config-001-20261120-01

Verbatim copies, committed for WI-WFC-BETA1-BP7-ARCHIVE-EQUIVALENCE-HARNESS-002's
generalized equivalence test (tests/unit/test_archive_equivalence.py), of files
staged read-only at build/wfc/bp7-evidence-inputs/wfc-beta1-bp7-guidance-config-001-20261120-01/
(ignored by .gitignore, not available in a fresh checkout). That staged copy is
itself a verbatim read-only copy of
../workflow-coordinator-run-evidence/archive/unclassified/wfc-beta1-bp7-guidance-config-001-20261120-01
at the Evidence commit above (see build/wfc/bp7-evidence-inputs/PROVENANCE.txt).
real_run/ reconstructs the archived Run's own state-root and OPS directory
layout from that already-archived copy under
archive/unclassified/wfc-beta1-bp7-guidance-config-001-20261120-01/{run,ops}/
(its manifest.json records the original absolute locations under
/home/stefan/wfc-state and /home/stefan/wfc-ops, not reachable from every
sandbox; the equivalence test relocates a disposable working copy and edits
only the path-metadata fields that encode that relocation -- never a run
fact). legacy/ is not duplicated here: every fixture case shares the one
frozen historical baseline already committed at tests/fixtures/bp5/legacy/.

The checkout's run.json is committed under the neutral name run.fixture.json
(bytes and digest unchanged) to avoid a committed-fixture/test collision;
the equivalence test's relocation step materializes it back to run.json in
the disposable, temporary relocated state root only, never in this tree.

operator-plan.json and operator-summary.json have the same committed-fixture/
test collision (tests/unit/test_wfc_op.py globs the full runtime export for
those literal names), but are not given a renamed sibling file the way
run.json was: a same-content delete+add in one commit is itself the
rename-shaped CommitIntent that the Coordinator's staged-path reconciliation
(rename detection collapsing a delete+add pair to the destination only) is
documented to refuse. Their exact original bytes (digests unchanged, verified
in tests/unit/test_archive_equivalence.py's setUp) are instead embedded
verbatim in that test module as _BP7_OPERATOR_PLAN_JSON/_BP7_OPERATOR_SUMMARY_JSON
(on the BP7 FixtureCase's own embedded_files) and are not committed here as
separate files.

No source record was changed; every hash below matches both
build/wfc/bp7-evidence-inputs/wfc-beta1-bp7-guidance-config-001-20261120-01/manifest.json's
own copied_files digests (independently re-verified against the staged
copy's own bytes before this fixture was built) and this directory's own
committed bytes.
